title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
description: A beginner course for school leavers who want to protect themselves, their families and small businesses online, and to explore a career in cybersecurity. You will learn to spot scams like phishing, smishing and SIM-swap fraud, lock down your accounts and phone, and respond calmly when something goes wrong.
outcomes: Recognise phishing, smishing, M-Pesa and SIM-swap scams before they cost you money
Create strong passwords, use a password manager and turn on two-factor authentication
Browse, use public Wi-Fi and social media more safely
Secure your phone and keep reliable backups
Respond to and report a hacked account or fraud incident
Plan your first steps towards a cybersecurity career
